session_contract_review.moving_duration_interpretation: Garmin's 30.1-minute movingDuration is not a credible measure of actual movement on this steep rooted and stepped hike. The FIT records 173.2 minutes elapsed with no timer pauses; slow vertical movement was repeatedly below Garmin's horizontal-speed threshold. Use elapsed time and the ascent/top/descent phase trace, not reported movingDuration, for coaching and calibration.

heart_rate_response_vs_effort.source_provenance: Original FIT contains only local/onboard device_info sources and no ANT, ANT+, Bluetooth, or BLE external-HR device record. A proprietary paired-device record names HRM 200, but does not establish it as the active source. Treat the activity HR as Fenix 6 wrist optical with high confidence, while retaining normal wrist-HR measurement limitations.
heart_rate_response_vs_effort.interpretation: The whole-session average was diluted by approximately 30 minutes in the top band and a low-HR descent. The ascent was meaningful controlled aerobic work despite RPE 3; aerobic training effect was 2.5 and Garmin load was 51.2.

altitude_trace.interpretation: The photo-derived signed rise of about 341 m closely validates Garmin's 343.8 m relative range. Garmin absolute elevation was about 9-12 m below the photographed watch/start and summit sign, so relative gain is stronger evidence than absolute high point.

activity_time_oxygenation_and_stress.interpretation: Neither Connect activity detail nor the original FIT contains activity SpO2 or respiration. All all-day stress samples during the hike were Garmin negative sentinels, so daily average stress must not be assigned to the climb.

body_battery_trace.interpretation: Body Battery showed an acute same-day drain but is a modeled co-diagnostic signal, not a direct energy measurement.

session_contract_review.technical_quality_notes: No general descent-leg fatigue. Near the end, slight right-knee discomfort occurred only on large step-downs. This is treated as a local eccentric step-down tolerance/control signal, not a systemic fatigue conclusion or diagnosis.
session_contract_review.footing_and_weather: Rooted and stepped forest trail with mist and cloud at the signed 2232 m high point; Mount Kinabalu was obscured.
session_contract_review.fueling_interpretation: Very low carbohydrate intake; an exact value is not inferred without egg size or nutrition-label evidence.
session_contract_review.hydration_interpretation: Garmin's water-loss value is modeled, not measured sweat loss. Without pre/post body mass, additional intake and urine data, the apparent 757 ml difference cannot establish dehydration.

next_morning_response.interpretation: Garmin next-day physiology was strong; athlete-subjective next-morning response was not reported.
